title: Auto Parry, Feint Protection, Smart Targeting, Profiles
features:
Free Features
Perfect Auto Parry — Includes M2 parries with configurable timing and calibration
Targeting Tools — Aim lock, camera lock, spectate, target lock and teleport-to-target
Target Filters — FOV, line-of-sight, health, friend, team and whitelist filtering
Player Utilities — Infinite jump, anti-fling, infinite stamina and anti-AFK
Rhythm Assistance — Rhythm anywhere with automatic calibration
ESP Suite — Highlights, names, boxes and health bars
Profiles & Performance — Five auto-saving profiles, smart mode routing and performance mode
Interface & Safety — UI customization and emergency stop
Server Tools — Rejoin, server hop and binding refresh

Premium Features
Combat Automation — Auto attack, heavy attack, block and dodge
Advanced Combat Settings — Attack range, intervals, facing checks and ping compensation
Defensive Automation — Auto punish, panic block, anti-stun and anti-ragdoll
Adaptive Parry System — Animation sync, adaptive learning, feint protection and multi-attack queue
Carry & Grip Automation — Auto carry, grip, revive and extended grip range
Advanced Movement — Speed bypass, fly and noclip
Cooldown Utilities — No dodge and dribble cooldown
Perfect Rhythm — Enhanced rhythm automation
Basketball Automation — Auto green, auto shoot and auto steal
Advanced ESP — Stamina ESP, tracers and combat attributes
